58d5d8302327: Not for everyday time tracking in Sales Cloud or Service Cloud. Most teams build a Time Entry custom object with a date, a start and an end time, and a link to a weekly Time Sheet. MultiDatePick puts a calendar on that Time Sheet, so people log their week by clicking days and dragging hours, and every block saves as a Time Entry record.
a5d319c1f0d6: How do I log the same hours on several days in Salesforce?
27f2550f8090: With the MultiDatePick Dates & Times component, click the days, then drag the hours once, for example 9:00 to 12:00 and 1:00 to 5:00 PM. Every picked day gets the same hours and each block saves as its own record. For a whole week, Add Recurring Pattern picks every weekday up to an end date. Turn on Allow Different Times Per Date when each day needs its own hours.
31bf6d609b74: How do I total hours on a Salesforce timesheet?
2a25b79fb629: Add an Hours formula field to the Time Entry, (End_Time__c - Start_Time__c) / 3600000, and roll it up to the weekly Time Sheet with a Roll-Up Summary field over a master-detail relationship. Add filtered roll-ups for Approved Hours, Billable Hours and Non-billable Hours. All of them are point-and-click Salesforce fields and update as entries are saved.
0757e56c79eb: How do I track billable and non-billable hours in Salesforce?
acaf47e6e43b: Add a Billing picklist with Billable and Non-billable to the Time Entry and set it as the calendar's Second Picklist Field. People pick it next to the task while logging time, Billable comes in as the default, and it shows on the hover card and in the Agenda. Two filtered roll-ups on the Time Sheet total each kind, and a Mark non-billable button in Edit Mode changes many entries at once.
7e9b24081d78: Can a manager approve timesheets in bulk in Salesforce?
5cb8a17c79c5: Yes. On a Team Time page that shows every entry, the manager turns on Edit Mode, picks the days, and sets Change status to Approved for every listed entry at once. Custom buttons that run a Flow, such as Submit week for the person logging time, appear in Edit Mode too and act only on the statuses they are set for.
d7339821a699: Can someone log two separate shifts on one day?
94319229a6e9: Yes. Pick a day that already has time logged and its blocks show as taken in the time grid; drag a new block, such as an evening on-call, and it saves as one more entry. Max Bookings per Day sets how many separate blocks a person can pick on one day, with 0 for no limit.

67248a54213e: <t1>Save.</t1> Each block becomes a Time Entry in Draft, linked to the time sheet. The Week view shows them straight away.
